_meta.primary_source: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper No. 56, Table 19 — 'Typical soil water characteristics for different soil types'. theta_FC and theta_WP are the midpoints of the ranges given in that table; the ranges themselves are kept in *_range for transparency.
_meta.infiltration_source: Basic (steady-state) infiltration rates: indicative ranges from FAO Irrigation Water Management Training Manual No. 5, Table 3. Used only to cap a single irrigation application depth, never to compute crop water demand.
_meta.warning: These are textbook reference profiles by texture class, not laboratory analyses of a specific plot. Replace theta_FC / theta_WP with measured values when available — the engine reads them from the database, so a per-field override requires no code change.
